description:
One task entering a Board lane; the `board:lanes` entry's fields. It never carries a title, a description, a
holder or any session detail.

task.description: The task key that changed lane.
task.title: Task

lane.description: The id of the Board machine state the task entered.
lane.title: Lane

time.description: When the task entered the lane, in epoch seconds.
time.title: Time

team.description: The task's team key; empty on an entry replayed from the history.
team.title: Team

milestone.description: The task's milestone; empty when it has none.
milestone.title: Milestone

labels.description: The task's labels; empty when it has none.
labels.title: Labels

assignee.description: Who or which agent model held the task; empty when unassigned, and a person's name.
assignee.title: Assignee

title: LaneEvent
